title: Authoritative virtual collections and RangeRequested
summary: Large collections remain application/server-owned. Swing consumes authoritative resident-window metadata, projects a proportional renderer-private viewport, and emits bounded RangeRequested demand without traversing the source or mutating resident rows.
invariants: RangeRequested(start,count) is demand, not permission to read source/backing storage.
Stable Wire element identity and event-time renderedRevision are captured when demand is emitted.
Server v0.17 flat windowOffset/windowLimit/windowTotalCount metadata and compact rangeWindow compatibility feed the same renderer-private viewport.
Applying authoritative window metadata must not echo RangeRequested.
A final partial window may contain fewer resident rows than windowLimit; Swing clamps renderer extent without rewriting server authority.

provenance.claim: Real ooRexx/BSF Server v0.17 200,000-row demand/reconcile/patch round trip including final partial window.
